caseName: HCA Health Services of Texas, Inc. v. Washington
caseNameFull: HCA Health Services of Texas, Inc., dba Spring Branch Medical Center v. Washington

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Sutton v. United Air Lines, Inc., ante, p. 471, and Murphy v. United Parcel Service, Inc., ante, p. 516.
